max_solar_zone_m2.note: Half of the 12,000 m² roof reserved as a teaching allocation; remaining roof is held for cooling, access and other needs. Actual layout not validated.

module_coverage_of_zone.note: Module surface within the allocated solar zone; the rest represents spacing/access. No surveyed packing.

module_dc_kw_per_m2.note: Authored 200 Wp/m² nameplate density; not a selected product.

constant_facility_demand_mw.note: Additional flat-load assumption for self-consumption only; baseline is an annual average and does not establish an actual hourly load profile.

all_modelled_pv_self_consumed.note: Prepared array is far below the assumed flat demand; no export/storage credit. Net generation includes the selected PVGIS losses.

usable_depth_m.note: Authored volume/footprint illustration, not an engineered tank depth.

expansion_zone_m2.note: Authored reserve within existing hardstanding. Neither available land nor access fit is verified.

turf.geometry: Schematic protected strip inside the same campus; actual footprint, fire access, deliveries and utility fit unassessed.
turf.irrigation: Apply the inherited 300 mm/year delivered irrigation allowance to the additional retained turf.

comparison_policy.mode: Alternative design from the same preconstruction baseline; not an operating-building retrofit.
comparison_policy.missing_values: null means Not established, never zero
comparison_policy.scores: No universal environmental or approval score
